established precedent. S.’s poem continues an English tradition of political sonneteering,
of which Milton’s sonnets on public themes are the founding texts. Wordsworth’s recent
development of the Miltonic model in the Sonnets Dedicated to Liberty in Poems, In Two
Volumes (1807) — especially London, 1802 in which Milton is invoked — as well as his
additions to the series in Poems (1815) makes an especially apt comparison.
